remediations.action: Inverted sparse tensor mapping to indices = torch.stack([dst, src]) where dst = edge_index[1] and src = edge_index[0], normalized by in-degree deg = bincount(dst). Unified isolated node behavior to return zero incoming aggregate across both edge_index and adjacency_lists representations.

Upgraded self._graphs from defaultdict(nx.DiGraph) to defaultdict(nx.MultiDiGraph). Added key=rel_id in add_edge. Updated in_edges, out_edges, and edges queries to unpack 3-tuples (u, v, data). In detect_circular_ownership, constructed simple nx.DiGraph projection to preserve elementary cycle semantics without duplicate multi-edge permutations.
Replaced global self._adjacency reassignment in get_subgraph with local sub_adj dictionary. Updated _detect_subgraph_clusters to accept optional adjacency parameter.

Added as_of: datetime | None parameter across find_neighbors, get_subgraph, detect_cyclic_mule_rings, detect_smurfing_patterns, prune_expired_edges, and get_active_subgraph_tensors. Filtered relationships created after as_of in both in-memory BFS/DFS traversals and Neo4j Cypher queries. Fixed stream pruning in StreamingGraphService.add_transaction to prune relative to incoming transaction timestamp instead of machine wall-clock time.
remediations.verified_by: TestTemporalGraphIntegrity suite (5 tests: neighbors, subgraph, rings, smurfing, streaming tensors)

remediations.action: Added timezone awareness normalization in extract_node_features using .replace(tzinfo=UTC). Bounded age_days and hours_ago >= 0.0 and added finite vector sanitization np.nan_to_num.
Implemented invalidate_cache(entity_id=None) method with thread locking. Added np.all(np.isfinite(...)) assertions in train_local and infer_node_embedding to reject NaNs and infinities immediately.
Hardened Neo4j Cypher query in find_neighbors with WHERE n.id <> $entity_id to prevent cyclic return of root entity.
remediations.verified_by: Cypher query inspection and test suite
